name: short-request-panel
length: short (fixed for every job so words commissioned are comparable)
element_rules: Elements were written from the request text alone, before any generation, and must not be edited after the first job runs. Scored present/absent by a blind adult reader on one sampled path.

review.note: WP-0.2 acceptance requires review by the owner or a second agent; not yet done.

requests.text: a story about my dog who gets lost in the woods
elements: found or home again by the end

requests.text: a dragon who is scared of fire
me and my sister solving a mystery in an old castle
a robot that learns to play music
a pirate looking for treasure under the sea
a kid who wants to win the big race
a story about baking a cake for my grandma
exploring a cave with a friend
a rocket trip to another planet
a snowstorm on the night of the festival
elements: the festival goes on or changes

requests.text: an invention that goes wrong at school
elements: some lesson or repair by the end

requests.text: a knight who would rather be a gardener
a detective story with secret codes
a story about being brave at the doctor
dinosaurs waking up in a museum
elements: what happens to them by dawn

requests.text: a horse who will not jump the fence
a story about a dragon who is afraid of the dark
My daughter is moving to a new town and is nervous about starting at a new school. Please make a story about a lighthouse keeper's cat who has to find a new home and make a friend there.
elements: a move to a new home

requests.text: We want a story about a boy who is jealous of his baby brother, set on a farm during harvest. It should end with the two of them working together.
elements: the two work together at the end

requests.text: Please write a mystery about a missing school trophy, with a clever girl who notices small clues. The culprit should turn out to be someone with a good reason.
elements: a culprit with a good reason
